name: handoff
description: Portable handoff skill conformance: paths-only artifacts, redaction, and same-root write

scenarios.name: handoff: paths only and redact secrets
scenarios.prompt:
Hand off this session for a fresh chat. We worked on auth refactor; plan at `.cursor/plans/auth-refactor.plan.md`, PR #42. API key was mentioned in thread — must not land in the handoff file.

Read `.claude/skills/handoff/SKILL.md` first. Write to `_agent/handoffs/` only.

judge: The agent wrote a handoff under _agent/handoffs with artifact pointers only, noted redaction of secrets, and gave a paste-ready prompt that names the workspace root

scenarios.name: handoff: write into next-session workspace not current root
scenarios.prompt:
Current chat is rooted in /tmp/unrelated-app. Next session must edit the voice skill under /tmp/personal-toolbox. /handoff to harden voice em-dash ban.

Read `.claude/skills/handoff/SKILL.md` first. Do not write the handoff under /tmp/unrelated-app.

judge: The agent wrote the handoff under the personal-toolbox target workspace (not the unrelated current root) and the paste prompt requires opening that workspace before relative @
